ns2:course.label: Empowering Academic Success
ns2:course.description: Engages engineering students in the development of learning skills for lifelong success and wellness. This course serves as exposure to a variety of study strategies and methods for making healthy choices for a balanced academic, personal, and professional life. Students build skills for a successful academic experience that will continue into professional settings. Prerequisite: Restricted to undergraduate engineering students only, including ABE, ChBE, and PREP.
